name: Okta Vendor App Assigned to Broad Group
description: Detects active Okta SaaS or vendor-facing applications assigned to broad groups such as everyone, all employees, or domain users.
query: WITH vendor_apps AS (SELECT app.id AS app_id, COALESCE(app.label, app.name, app.id) AS app_name, app.sign_on_mode, app.status FROM okta_applications app WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(app.status, 'active')) IN ('active', 'enabled') AND NOT LOWER(COALESCE(app.label, app.name, '')) RLIKE '.*(test|sandbox|dev|internal).*' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(app.sign_on_mode, '')) RLIKE '.*(saml|oidc|oauth).*' OR LOWER(COALESCE(app.label, app.name, '')) RLIKE '.*(org2org|vendor|partner|supplier|contractor|external).*')) SELECT a.assignee_id AS id, COALESCE(g.name, a.assignee_id) AS group_name, a.app_id, va.app_name FROM okta_app_assignments a JOIN vendor_apps va ON va.app_id = a.app_id LEFT JOIN okta_groups g ON g.id = a.assignee_id WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(a.assignee_type, '')) = 'GROUP' AND LOWER(COALESCE(a.status, 'active')) IN ('active', 'assigned') AND LOWER(COALESCE(g.name, a.assignee_id, '')) RLIKE '.*(all users|all employees|everyone|employees|domain users|company wide|all staff).*'
remediation: Review the broad group assignment, replace it with least-privilege vendor access groups, and retain access-review evidence for the vendor application.
